queries:
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg) AS deviation
FROM type_avg;
SELECT budget_id, ABS(spent - amount) AS deviation FROM budget;
WITH t AS (
    SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent) AS avg_spent
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       (avg_spent - (SELECT AVG(avg_spent) FROM t)) * (avg_spent - (SELECT AVG(avg_spent) FROM t)) AS deviation
FROM t;
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type, AVG(b.spent) AS avg_spent
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

)
SELECT (MAX(avg_spent) - MIN(avg_spent)) * 100.0 / AVG(avg_spent) AS relative_difference_percent
FROM type_avg;
